text:
emma.docs: opened PR #1024 to update the pricing examples on rate-limits & quotas. TL;DR: switch all examples to "cost per 1k tokens" and remove ambiguous 'requests' examples. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 :mag:

noah: nice. do we also update the Go & Java SDK snippets? I spotted Go using client.Generate(...) which is legacy.

emma.docs: yes — replacing with Responses.Create in Go/Java, and updating all header examples to Authorization: Bearer.

zara: add a short snippet about interpreting the usage dashboard's "effective unit cost" column. People keep misreading it as monthly spend.

emma.docs: done. added a one-paragraph explanation and a worked example converting tokens -> 1k-token units -> cost.

noah: paste for Go suggestion:
```go
// Go SDK v2
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Responses.Create(context.Background(), redwood.CreateRequest{Model: "rwd-small", Input: "hi"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.OutputText)
```

noah: and Java snippet:
```java
RedwoodClient client = new RedwoodClient(System.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"));
Response r = client.responses().create(new CreateRequest().model("rwd-small").input("hi"));
System.out.println(r.outputText());
```

zara: QA note: dashboard panel id referenced in the docs was 415; current panel is 518. I added a redirect for the old panel in _redirects. Rule: "#/docs/usage#eff-cost  /dashboards/usage?panelId=518  301"

emma.docs: thanks. I also fixed a couple of broken internal links from the billing FAQ to the new quota page.

analytics-bot: preview build queued for branch docs/pricing-unit-costs. status: running checks (linkcheck, i18n-lint, snippet-sanity).

analytics-bot: linkcheck: passed. i18n-lint: warning (fr table overflow) — minor. snippet-sanity: passed.

noah: for the fr overflow, let's shorten column headers in fr.json in a follow-up PR, but keep the responsive table CSS tweak in this PR so mobile is okay.

emma.docs: added the CSS tweak and filed issue #123 for i18n.

deploybot: site deploy queued for branch docs/pricing-unit-costs. build started at 2026-03-24T09:03:10Z.

deploybot: preview available https://deploy-preview-1024--docs.redwood.ai. Anchors, snippets, and redirect test passed.

emma.docs: approving merge in 10 minutes if no objections. I'll ping support + sales with a short note about the unit-cost change so they can update customer-facing materials. :shipit:
